versions.changelog: Address security scan concerns: removed embedded device auth flow code (point users to deepread-agent-setup skill instead). Skill no longer modifies .env files. No CLI binary requirements. Simplified to focus purely on BYOK setup via dashboard.

Address security scan concerns: declared required binaries (curl, python3), clarified that .env file is appended (not silent file modification), added 'Key Storage Best Practices' section with guidance on scoped keys, .gitignore, secrets managers, and key rotation.
Fix rendering: replaced all markdown tables with bullet lists and bold labels. Matches OCR skill formatting that renders cleanly on ClawHub.
Fix: BYOK keys are managed via dashboard UI, not public API. Corrected setup guide.
Launch: Bring Your Own Key. Connect your OpenAI, Google, or OpenRouter API key to DeepRead. Zero LLM costs, unlimited pages, same API.
